data.summary: The `delta` directory is a scenario definition for installing the `delta` Git diff syntax-highlighting pager into a container image. It pairs a `scenario.toml` metadata file (consumed by `aio-config gen`) with a `fragment.Dockerfile` that performs the actual idempotent `mise use -g` installation and verifies the binary is reachable in both login and non-login shells. The directory contains no business logic; it is purely declarative infrastructure/configuration for reproducible tool provisioning.

file_insights.name: scenario.toml
file_insights.summary: Scenario metadata describing the `delta` tool package, its category, installer backend, and pinned version for `aio-config gen` fragment resolution.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains a header comment explaining that it is consumed by `aio-config gen`, then defines `id`, `name`, `description`, `category`, `installer`, and a single `[[versions]]` table pinning label and version to `0.19.2`.
file_insights.detailed_description: This TOML file is the declarative metadata entry that the `aio-config gen` tool reads to resolve and assemble container fragments. It identifies the scenario as `delta`, places it in the `shell` category, declares `mise` as the installer, and pins the version to 0.19.2. It is the source of truth for generating the corresponding fragment.Dockerfile step.
responsibilities: Declare scenario identity (id, name, description) for fragment resolution
Classify the scenario under the `shell` category
Pin the installed version of delta to 0.19.2

file_insights.name: fragment.Dockerfile
file_insights.summary: Dockerfile fragment that installs `delta` via `mise use -g` and verifies the binary is available in both login and non-login shells.
file_insights.source_summary: The file starts with a scenario marker comment and documentation about `delta` being the canonical binary name. It declares `ARG DELTA_VERSION={{version}}`, then runs `mise use -g "delta@${DELTA_VERSION}"`, lists the installed delta via `mise ls delta`, and performs two `command -v delta` checks under login and non-login shells, exiting with an error if the binary is missing.
file_insights.detailed_description: This fragment is a reusable container build layer that installs the `delta` Git diff pager at a version supplied through the `DELTA_VERSION` build argument. It leverages `mise use -g`'s read-modify-write semantics so the fragment composes idempotently with other mise-based tool fragments without requiring an aggregation step. It also asserts that the `delta` binary resolves on PATH under both `bash -lc` and `bash -c` invocations to catch environment-layer discrepancies early.
responsibilities: Accept the target delta version through the `DELTA_VERSION` build argument
Install the pinned delta version globally using the mise version manager
Verify the installed package is registered with mise via `mise ls`
Assert the `delta` binary is resolvable in both login and non-login shell environments
